aiReviews.claim: Dial String Terminator must be alphanumeric and must not exceed 1 bytes.
aiReviews.sourceDetail: Element 27 is AN, fixed one alphanumeric character. In DL2 it is A after the first dial string and F after the second.

aiReviews.claim: Dial String Type must be numeric and must not exceed 1 bytes.
aiReviews.sourceDetail: Element 28 is numeric, fixed one digit, and fixed value 1 for transaction dial strings.

sourceEvidence.quote: Character Type: AN Maximum Length: 1 byte
Representation: Fixed length of one alphanumeric character
A Indicates the end of the first dial string in the Dial String Data Segment (Data Segment No. DL2).
F Indicates the end of the second dial string in the Dial String Data Segment (Data Segment No. DL2).
Character Type: N Maximum Length: 1 byte
Representation: Fixed length of one digit

directDl2Rules.title: Dial String Type is fixed value 1; Primary Phone Number block is required
directDl2Rules.scope: DL2 primary phone block; includes fixed Dial String Type 1 and terminator A.

directDl2Rules.title: Phone Number is variable length; Dial String Type is fixed 1; Terminator A first/F second
directDl2Rules.scope: DL2 dial-string sequence and positional terminator values.
